subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction adopt the existing prompt-send policy of dropping aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization, accepting that those partial aborted turns are omitted from summaries?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but choosing drop instead of synthetic recovery controls user-visible session-state preservation after provider timeouts and should be explicitly owned by maintainers.

options.title: Accept Drop Policy
options.body: Proceed with this PR because it matches sibling replay/prompt-send behavior and prevents strict-provider session breakage with bounded context loss.

options.title: Require Synthetic Recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that preserves aborted turns by synthesizing explicit tool results, accepting the risk of fabricated context and a larger policy surface.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Hold this PR and design richer aborted-turn recovery separately, leaving the current compaction failure open until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Accept Drop Policy
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR because it matches sibling replay/prompt-send behavior and prevents strict-provider session breakage with bounded context loss.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history tie to the shared transcript repair contract this decision extends into compaction.
